mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notices ( title, content, category, writer_id, target_role, is_important, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{category}, #{writerId}, #{targetRole}, #{important}, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO notice_attachments ( notice_id, file_name, original_file_name, file_path, file_type, file_size, is_deleted, uploaded_at ) VALUES ( #{noticeId}, #{fileName}, #{originalFileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, FALSE, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, notice_id AS noticeId, file_name AS fileName, original_file_name AS originalFileName, file_path AS filePath, file_type AS fileType, file_size AS fileSize, download_count AS downloadCount, is_deleted AS deleted, uploaded_at AS uploadedAt FROM notice_attachments WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT id, title, content, category, writer_id AS writerId, view_count AS viewCount, is_important AS important, target_role AS targetRole, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM notices ORDER BY is_important DESC, created_at DESC

SELECT n.id AS id, n.title, n.content, n.category, n.writer_id AS writerId, u.name AS writerName, n.view_count AS viewCount, n.is_important AS important, n.target_role AS targetRole, n.created_at AS createdAt, n.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM notices n LEFT JOIN users u ON n.writer_id = u.id ORDER BY n.is_important DESC, n.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT n.id AS id, n.title, n.content, n.category, n.writer_id AS writerId, u.name AS writerName, n.view_count AS viewCount, n.is_important AS important, n.target_role AS targetRole, n.created_at AS createdAt, n.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM notices n LEFT JOIN users u ON n.writer_id = u.id WHERE n.target_role = 'ALL' OR n.target_role = #{userRole} OR n.target_role IS NULL ORDER BY n.is_important DESC, n.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notices WHERE target_role = 'ALL' OR target_role = #{userRole} OR target_role IS NULL

SELECT n.id, n.title, n.content, n.category, n.writer_id AS writerId, u.name AS writerName, n.updated_by AS updatedBy, n.view_count AS viewCount, n.is_important AS important, n.visible_from AS visibleFrom, n.visible_until AS visibleUntil, n.target_role AS targetRole, n.created_at AS createdAt, n.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM notices n LEFT JOIN users u ON n.writer_id = u.id WHERE n.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE notices SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, is_important = #{important}, visible_from = #{visibleFrom}, visible_until = #{visibleUntil}, target_role = #{targetRole}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, n.category, u.name AS writerName FROM notice_attachments a LEFT JOIN notices n ON a.notice_id = n.id LEFT JOIN users u ON n.writer_id = u.id WHERE a.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY a.uploaded_at DESC

SELECT * FROM notices
category = #{category}
AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY is_important DESC, created_at DESC
